description: This file defines a custom exception class 'DepositAccountNotFoundException' used in the savings portfolio module of the Apache Fineract project. It extends a generic resource not found exception and provides constructors to handle cases where a deposit account with a specific ID and type is not found.

classes.name: DepositAccountNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a deposit account of a certain type and ID was not found in the system. It extends the generic resource not found exception and provides constructors to specify error message details.

methods.name: DepositAccountNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a formatted error message based on the account type and ID.

methods.name: DepositAccountNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a formatted error message based on the account type, ID, and an underlying cause exception.
